Write code that moderates a batch of user messages and returns per-message decisions using a concrete provider.

You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: Amazon Comprehend / Bedrock Guardrails
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_toxic_content, apply_guardrail
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/trust-safety.html

  Service: Alibaba Content Moderation
  SDK: alibabacloud_green
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: text/scan
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/331920.html

Option 3 — Perspective API:
  Service: Perspective API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: comments:analyze
  Setup hints: PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.perspectiveapi.com/s/

Option 4 — Tisane:
  Service: Tisane Text Moderation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: POST /parse
  Setup hints: TISANE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.tisane.ai/

Option 5 — watsonx guardrails:
  Service: watsonx.ai guardrails / HAP detection
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: HAP detection, text detection
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/watsonxdata/premium/2.3.x?topic=prompts-removing-harmful-content

output_text:
import os
import requests
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


PERSPECTIVE_API_URL = "https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze"


def _to_toxicity_decision(score: float, threshold: float) -> str:
    return "block" if score >= threshold else "allow"


def moderate_messages(
    messages: List[str],
    threshold: float = 0.7,
    requested_attributes: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    language: str = "en",
    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Moderate a batch of user messages using Perspective API.

    Returns a list of per-message decision dictionaries:
    {
        "message": <original message>,
        "decision": "allow" | "block",
        "score": <toxicity score or None>,
        "reason": <string or None>,
        "error": <string or None>
    }
    """
    if requested_attributes is None:
        requested_attributes = ["TOXICITY"]

    if api_key is None:
        api_key = os.getenv("PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY")

    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("Missing Perspective API key. Set PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY or pass api_key.")

    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    for message in messages:
        payload = {
            "comment": {"text": message},
            "requestedAttributes": {attr: {} for attr in requested_attributes},
            "languages": [language],
            "doNotStore": True,
        }

        try:
            response = requests.post(
                PERSPECTIVE_API_URL,
                params={"key": api_key},
                json=payload,
                timeout=timeout,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            attrs = data.get("attributeScores", {})
            toxicity_score = None
            if "TOXICITY" in attrs:
                toxicity_score = (
                    attrs["TOXICITY"]
                    .get("summaryScore", {})
                    .get("value")
                )
            elif attrs:
                first_attr = next(iter(attrs.values()))
                toxicity_score = first_attr.get("summaryScore", {}).get("value")

            if toxicity_score is None:
                decision = "allow"
                reason = "No toxicity score returned"
            else:
                decision = _to_toxicity_decision(float(toxicity_score), threshold)
                reason = f"toxicity_score={toxicity_score:.4f}, threshold={threshold:.4f}"

            results.append(
                {
                    "message": message,
                    "decision": decision,
                    "score": toxicity_score,
                    "reason": reason,
                    "error": None,
                }
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            results.append(
                {
                    "message": message,
                    "decision": "allow",
                    "score": None,
                    "reason": None,
                    "error": str(exc),
                }
            )

    return results
